title: A Modular ASP.NET Core MVC Application With Orchard Core | Orchard Core
description:
A modular ASP.NET Core MVC application splits into a web application, which supplies the layout, and modules, which bring their own controllers, views and routes. Orchard Core's templates create both, and a project reference connects them.

This video creates a web application and a module from the templates, reads the code they contain, runs the application, and registers a route so that the module answers requests for the home page.

In this video:
• What you build: a web application, a module and a reference
• Creating the projects with the Orchard Core templates
• The web application: Program.cs, the project file and the layout
• The module: project file, manifest, controller, view and Startup class
• How Orchard Core finds the module
• Running the application and the default address of the module
• A route for the home page
